name: margin_threshold_train_only
purpose: verify margin threshold is computed using training subjects only
pass_criterion: no validation subject label contributes to threshold

name: non_tie_pair_count_sufficient
pass_criterion: each task/fold has at least 1000 validation pairs and at least 500 training pairs after balancing

name: direction_balance_after_sampling
purpose: verify class balance artifact is reduced
pass_criterion: positive direction fraction is within [0.45, 0.55] for every training fold and within [0.40, 0.60] for validation audit

name: fold_locality_guard
purpose: verify pairs never cross LOSO fold boundaries
pass_criterion: validation pairs only contain the held-out subject; training pairs exclude held-out subject

name: task_scope_guard
purpose: verify arousal is primary and valence is guard only
pass_criterion: future first-pass objective cannot expand beyond the selected scope without a separate review

name: baseline_control_sanity
purpose: verify no-training baselines stay near chance
pass_criterion: random/majority controls remain in expected range before any first-pass execution
